summary: Iteration 6 review PASSED end-to-end. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): fresh visit to '/' renders welcome-screen with welcome-logo, welcome-start (→ /onboarding/terms) and welcome-login (→ /onboarding/account). Regression: /drive?lat=40.4168&lng=-3.7038&place=Sol&fromLat=40.45&fromLng=-3.69 renders with Azure static map and 'Gire a la derecha en Calle de Santiago Bernabéu' + 'en 110 m · 21 min · 7.5 km · llegada 21:32'; /privacy and /profile both render without red screens. Console: only the known-ignorable RN Web deprecation warnings + expected 402/401 network errors for background probes.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/media.py:52-75 (upload_photo) — Correct: rejects missing EMERGENT_KEY with 503, whitelists jpeg/png/webp (415 otherwise), caps at 6 MB (413), stores under sentinel-family/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.{ext} in Emergent Object Storage, and reflects has_photo=true on both users doc and every members row of the user (so /groups/{gid}/positions can surface has_photo without an extra join).

routers/media.py:85-118 (viewer + user_photo) — Correct dual-token flow (Bearer header or ?token= for ), verifies access token type=='access', and permission check is 'owner OR shares any active group with viewer' → returns 403 for strangers as required. Response includes Cache-Control: private, max-age=300 which is safe for private images. Uses run_in_threadpool around blocking `requests` calls, keeping the event loop responsive.

routers/groups.py:134-143 (delete_group) — Owner-only soft delete (deleted_at set), all members flipped to 'removed', outstanding invitations cancelled. `_group_for(..., admin=True)` returns 404 on a missing/deleted group, so the second DELETE correctly yields 404 (not 403). Confirmed by test_delete_group_lifecycle.
routers/auth.py:73-86 (register) — onboarding.step is now 'profile' as required by iteration 6 (welcome → legal → account → PROFILE → group → map). No functional issues.

frontend/app/onboarding/profile.tsx:63 — Stale copy: 'Foto e ilustración personalizada: SERVICIO NO CONFIGURADO'. Since the storage integration is live and tested, this line is misleading and should be removed or rewritten. Not blocking.
